SELECT timestamp,source,
CASE WHEN source='edge_logs' THEN CASE WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/sign/') THEN 'storage_signed_url' WHEN startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/') THEN 'storage_object_transfer' ELSE 'other' END ELSE log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] END AS operation,
CASE WHEN source='edge_logs' THEN log_attributes['request.method'] ELSE log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'] END AS method_or_state,
CASE WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN left(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(log_attributes['parsed.query'], '\\x27[^\\x27]*\\x27', '?'), '\\b[0-9]+\\b', '?'),5000) ELSE '' END AS redacted_sql,
CASE WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN left(replaceRegexpAll(replaceRegexpAll(log_attributes['parsed.context'], '\\x27[^\\x27]*\\x27', '?'), '\\b[0-9]+\\b', '?'),1200) ELSE '' END AS redacted_context,
CASE WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN CASE WHEN startsWith(event_message,'duration:') THEN 'duration_statement' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'canceling statement due to statement timeout')>0 THEN 'statement_timeout' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'canceling statement due to user request')>0 THEN 'user_cancel' ELSE 'other' END ELSE '' END AS event_class,
length(log_attributes['parsed.query']) AS query_length,
log_attributes['response.origin_time'] AS origin_ms, log_attributes['response.status_code'] AS status
FROM logs WHERE
(source='postgres_logs' AND (log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code']='57014' OR (log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] IN ('supabase/dashboard','mgmt-api') AND positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0)))
OR (source='edge_logs' AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/') AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.headers.user_agent'],'Dart/') AND log_attributes['request.method'] IN ('POST','PUT','PATCH'))
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 20

with candidates as (
        select
        pub.schemaname,
        pub.tablename
        from
        pg_publication_tables pub
        where
        pub.pubname = $1
        and pub.schemaname like (case $2 when '*' then '%' else $2 end) escape ''
        and pub.tablename like (case $3 when '*' then '%' else $3 end) escape ''
     ),
     sub_tables as (
        select
        format('%I.%I', c.schemaname, c.tablename)::regclass entity
        from
        candidates c
        where
        -- A name that matches a published schema or table exactly selects only that one, so
        -- `item_1` doesn't also pick up `items1`. Otherwise `_` and `%` stay LIKE wildcards.
        ($2 = '*' or c.schemaname = $2 or not exists (select 1 from candidates e where e.schemaname = $2))
        and ($3 = '*' or c.tablename = $3 or not exists (select 1 from candidates e where e.tablename = $3))
     )
     insert into realtime.subscription as x(
        subscription_id,
        entity,
        filters,
        claims,
        action_filter,
        selected_columns
      )
      select
        $4::text::uuid,
        sub_tables.entity,
        -- Build the realtime.user_defined_filter[] server-side from primitive type arrays
        -- instead of binding a list of composite tuples. Postgrex caches the composite type's
        -- field count per connection at bootstrap and never refreshes it, so a long-lived
        -- connection whose cache predates an ALTER TYPE on user_defined_filter would otherwise
        -- encode against a stale arity and crash with :badarg. Constructing the rows here keeps
        -- the arity resolved by the server's current catalog.
        (
          select coalesce(
            array_agg(row(c, o::realtime.equality_op, v, n)::realtime.user_defined_filter),
            '{}'::realtime.user_defined_filter[]
          )
          from unnest($6::text[], $7::text[], $8::text[], $9::boolean[]) as f(c, o, v, n)
        ),
        $5,
        $10,
        $11
      from
        sub_tables
        on conflict
        -- coalesce needed: NULL != NULL in unique constraints; NULL selected_columns means all columns
        (subscription_id, entity, filters, action_filter, coalesce(selected_columns, '{}'))
        do update set
        claims = excluded.claims,
        created_at = now()
      returning
         id

SELECT wal->>'type' as type,
       wal->>'schema' as schema,
       wal->>'table' as table,
       COALESCE(wal->>'columns', '[]') as columns,
       COALESCE(wal->>'record', '{}') as record,
       COALESCE(wal->>'old_record', '{}') as old_record,
       wal->>'commit_timestamp' as commit_timestamp,
       subscription_ids,
       errors,
       slot_changes_count
FROM realtime.list_changes($1, $2, $3, $4)

WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."riders"."id", "public"."riders"."current_lat", "public"."riders"."current_lng", "public"."riders"."current_heading", row_to_json("riders_rider_kyc_1".*)::jsonb AS "rider_kyc" FROM "public"."riders" LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT "rider_kyc_1"."vehicle_type" FROM "public"."rider_kyc" AS "rider_kyc_1" WHERE "rider_kyc_1"."id" = "public"."riders"."kyc_id"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 ) AS "riders_rider_kyc_1" ON TRUE WHERE  "public"."riders"."account_status" = $3 AND NOT "public"."riders"."current_lat" IS NULL AND  "public"."riders"."current_lat" >= $4 AND  "public"."riders"."current_lat" <= $5 AND NOT "public"."riders"."current_lng" IS NULL AND  "public"."riders"."current_lng" >= $6 AND  "public"."riders"."current_lng" <= $7   LIMIT $8 OFFSET $9 )  SELECT null::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), '[]') AS body, nullif(current_setting('response.headers', true), '') AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting('response.status', true), '') AS response_status, '' AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t
